comment: Outbound URL policy exceptions (docs/SANDBOX-DEPLOY.md 1.9). Empty means the deployment default: the control plane fetches public http(s) only. Add one entry per internal destination, with its ports, e.g. {"host": "mcp.internal.example.com", "ports": [443]} or {"cidr": "10.20.0.0/16", "ports": [8443]}. This file is parsed at startup; a typo fails the boot.
